content.text: Section 18 meets the preferred position on every material term. No redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position on every material term: Vendor-funded coverage for the term plus one year, commercial general liability of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (Brightline processes Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, which the preferred position expects. The clause also exceeds the preferred position with employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, a reputable-insurer and primary-coverage requirement, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all of which benefit us. No deviation; nothing to redline.
